page.overview:
Who is Nole Markham?

is the main protagonist of Blackbird, the first story in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He is a cool young man who is haunted by an entity intent on punishing him for his mean behavior.

Nole is six-foot-one with blue eyes, an athletic build, and scruffy blond hair. He also has a white scar below his left knee from falling off his bike after being chased by a goose. Nole usually wears faded jeans, white shirts, a watch, and leather jackets when the weather allows it. He sleeps in just his white boxer briefs.

Nole tries to act cool and confident, usually with nonchalant posturing. He also enjoys having fun, which can make him somewhat of a slacker and clueless at times. Still, Nole cares about film enough to get serious and focus. He's also a minimalist, keeping very little in his room. Nole’s desire to be cool makes him act rather mean, ruthlessly bullying others in junior high. By college he still finds his past cruelty funny and has a habit of pushing too far and getting offensive with his jokes. However, Nole begins to reflect on his past and feels guilty over his actions, leading to him attempting to better himself as a person. When stressed, he’ll usually say his thoughts aloud. Nole can also usually sleep through anything, although his experiences with the Blackbird keep him up at night.

When Nole was in junior high school, he bullied a girl named Christine. Due to the poor state of her clothes, Nole subjected her to constant torment and even convinced his classmates to join in on the bullying.
